signal_evidence.services_demand: MAU grew by 10 million to 761 million in total, surpassing our guidance by 2 million. Our growth rate accelerated 12% year-over-year, up from 11% in quarter 4.
signal_evidence.capex_direction: We expect operating expenses to remain at these levels for the next quarter or 2... it's a mix of increased compute, not increased headcount... we are training rather large models in-house.
signal_evidence.pricing_power: We saw no surprises with respect to price increase related churn following our January U.S. price increase... ARPU expansion of 5.7% year-over-year.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: We reiterate our previous statement that we expect another full year of healthy subscriber growth... we continue to expect both to improve in 2026 on a full year basis.
